name: pull-to-refresh
title: Pull To Refresh
description: Pull a list down from its top to load what is new, the gesture a phone reader already knows. The pull is one finger and one path, so it always has a twin: a Refresh button that is visible wherever the pointer is a mouse, and reachable by keyboard and…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/pull-to-refresh

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/pull-to-refresh.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/pull-to-refresh';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/pull-to-refresh

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
